rows.location: course/modules/AP/AP1/L07.html line 113: 'the sample variance bound of Lesson 5 is biased upward, and so is the sample maximum Sharpe ratio it equals'
rows.evidence: Theorem 3.3 gives E[Var_T(x-hat*)] >= Var(x*), i.e. an upward bias of the squared bound. The maximum Sharpe ratio equals R_f sigma(x*), a square root of the variance; sqrt is concave, so Jensen goes the other way and the theorem does not imply an upward bias of the Sharpe ratio itself. The sentence asserts an unproved result as part of a T-graded passage.
rows.fix: Change to 'and so is the square of the sample maximum Sharpe ratio it equals' (which Theorem 3.3 proves), or add a cited/proved result for the unsquared ratio.
